en: Good morning guys.
zh: 早上好，大家。

en: It is Saturday morning.
zh: 现在是星期六的早上。

en: I'm on Ko Tao Island still.
zh: 我还在龟岛。

en: Just been to the gym.
zh: 刚刚去健了个身。

en: Now I'm sitting at this beautiful cafe on the beach waiting for my coffee and my juice.
zh: 现在我坐在海滩边一家很漂亮的咖啡馆里，等我的咖啡和果汁。

en: It's my last day here in Thailand.
zh: 这是我在泰国的最后一天了。

en: Tomorrow is a full transit day so I'm just gonna soak up the vibes and enjoy it.
zh: 明天是整整一天的转机时间，所以今天我就打算好好感受氛围，享受一下。

en: I basically had a full day of diving yesterday.
zh: 昨天基本上一整天都在潜水。

en: I think it only cost me about a hundred and fifty dollars Australian.
zh: 我记得大概只花了150澳元左右。

en: and we did a refresher course because I hadn't dived in about 15 months
zh: 我们还上了一个复习课程，因为我大概15个月没潜水了，

en: since I last did a scuba dive so I had to do a refresher course.
zh: 上次水肺潜水还是很久以前了，所以需要上个复习课。

en: And then we did a dive to one of the islands out that way.
zh: 之后我们去那边一个小岛潜了一次。

en: Some beautiful coral and marine life so.
zh: 有美丽的珊瑚和海洋生物。

en: yeah, it was awesome.
zh: 所以，真的很棒。

en: I would definitely come back here and do my advanced diving course.
zh: 我绝对还会再来这里，考一个进阶潜水证。

en: But yeah, it's my last day here in Thailand.
zh: 不过是的，这是我在泰国的最后一天了。

en: I don't know how to feel about it, to be honest.
zh: 说实话，我也不知道自己什么心情。

en: I know when I go back home I've got a lot of things to deal with in terms of work and figuring out my life.
zh: 我知道回去之后，有好多事情得处理，比如工作和自己的生活。

en: Yeah, I'm definitely gonna miss Thailand.
zh: 是啊，我肯定会想念泰国的。

en: I'm gonna have to come back here.
zh: 我一定会再回来的。

en: I reckon there's so many other islands that I wanna check out.
zh: 我觉得这里还有好多岛屿我还想去看看。

en: Anyway, I'm gonna enjoy my coffee and my juice and soak up the last day of the island vibes.
zh: 总之，我现在要享受我的咖啡和果汁，好好感受岛上的最后一天。

en: Peace.
zh: 拜。
